correctness.rationale: Induction on unary terms in {0,min, Gödel residuum, a↦1−a} restricts outputs on each of five regions {0},(0,1/2),{1/2},(1/2,1),{1} to {0,x,1−x,1}; symbolic candidate comparisons are constant inside each region. The five definable crisp masks Z, L∧¬G R∧¬G Z, L∧R, R∧¬G L∧¬G O, O realize all independent choices. Local distinct choice counts 2,4,3,4,2 multiply to 192, separated by 0,1/4,1/2,3/4,1. A finite equally spaced symmetric chain intersects all five regions iff odd n≥5. Absent midpoint (even n) and absent strict interior (n=3) supply explicit separating identities. Independently rebuilt closure gives n=2..8 counts 4,12,64,192,64,192,64; those finite checks supplement, not replace the continuum argument.
